title: Sample and Variant (2025)
headline: The mechanism used to prove Theorem 2 did not work as printed. The authors agreed and published a corrigendum crediting this audit; the corrected rules were audited and no defect was found.

work.title: Implementing Club Formation with Simple Messages

claims.label: Theorem 2: club mechanism, Rules (a)–(c)
claims.gist: The three-rule mechanism implements every efficient club structure.
claims.statement: For at least three agents, the mechanism defined by Rules (a)–(c) implements in Nash equilibrium every efficient club structure satisfying conditions E1 and E2.
claims.quantifiers: for every number of agents and every structure satisfying E1 and E2

result.summary: An unwanted equilibrium survives the printed rules; Theorem 2 itself is not refuted.
result.witness: With three agents and two clubs, a message profile in which agents name different club sizes is an equilibrium whose outcome is not efficient. Rule (b) does not penalise it.
result.tested: All message profiles for three to five agents with up to three clubs and announced sizes up to six.
not_claimed: Theorem 2 asserts that some implementing mechanism exists; that statement is not refuted.
Conditions E1 and E2 are not claimed to be insufficient.
result.repair_note: Requiring agents to agree on the announced size removes the equilibrium in all cases checked.

vor_check.detail: Statement, definitions and the decisive step checked on rendered pages of the published version.

checks.detail: A separate AI session, not given the earlier result, found the same equilibrium.
The researcher enumerated the message profiles with separate code.
The authors agreed in writing that the printed rules admit the equilibrium.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

claims.novelty: No earlier report found in the searched literature.

claims.label: Corrected Rules (a)–(c) (corrigendum)
claims.gist: The corrected mechanism implements every efficient club structure.
claims.statement: With Rule (b) amended to require agreement on the announced club size, the mechanism implements every efficient club structure satisfying E1 and E2.
conditions: Rule (b) as amended in the corrigendum

result.summary: No unwanted equilibrium among all profiles checked; the amended proof read line by line.
result.search_scope: All message profiles for three to six agents with up to three clubs and sizes up to eight, including the profiles that broke the original rules. The corrigendum's proof read line by line.
result.limits: Larger message spaces are covered by the proof reading only.

vor_check.detail: The corrigendum's statement and proof checked on rendered pages.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

author_position.summary: The authors agreed that the printed rules admit an unwanted equilibrium and said they would publish a correction.

correction.note: The corrigendum amends Rule (b) and thanks this audit for the counterexample.

history.label: Checked against the published version: full
Corrected rules audited: no defect found

changelog.change: Added the published corrigendum and an audit of the corrected rules.

statements.ai_use: Discovery and the separate rechecks used AI models in separate sessions. The independent reproduction, the version-of-record check and every editorial decision were done by the researcher.
